expectations.text: Flags MFA scope gap against IA.L2-3.5.3 (MFA required for local and network access to privileged accounts and network access to non-privileged accounts — cloud email alone is insufficient)
expectations.evidence: Gap table row: 'IA.L2-3.5.3 | IA | MFA for local/network access, privileged & non-privileged | PARTIAL ... MFA confirmed only on cloud email. No indication MFA covers VPN, domain logon, file shares, or other CUI-touching apps. Critical practice — must be fully MET before any certification, cannot sit in POA&M.'

expectations.text: Flags FIPS-validated cryptography gap (SC.L2-3.13.11 requires FIPS-validated cryptography to protect CUI confidentiality) and the flat-network/shared-drive state against scoping and SC.L2-3.13.1/AC.L2-3.1.3 (boundary protection / control CUI flow), recommending segmentation or an enclave
expectations.evidence: 'SC.L2-3.13.11 | SC | Employ FIPS-validated cryptography | NOT MET ... Same root cause as above.' Also 'AC.L2-3.1.3 | AC | Control the flow of CUI per approved authorizations | NOT MET ... Flat network with CUI on shared drives = no flow control or enclave boundary.' Remediation step 2: 'Segment CUI off the flat network (AC.L2-3.1.3, SC.L2-3.13.16, MP.L2-3.8.1/3.8.2) — move CUI off open shared drives into an access-controlled, encrypted enclave.'

expectations.text: Flags untested IR plan against IR.L2-3.6.3 (test incident response capability) and the stale SSP against CA.L2-3.12.4 (SSP must be current)
expectations.evidence: 'IR.L2-3.6.3 | IR | Test the incident response capability | NOT MET ... Explicitly stated: plan has never been tested.' And 'CA.L2-3.12.4 | CA | Develop, document, and periodically update the SSP | PARTIAL/NOT MET ... SSP last updated 2022 — four years stale...'

expectations.text: Correctly credits compliant items (awareness training AT.L2-3.2.1/.2; personnel screening PS.L2-3.9.1) instead of marking everything deficient
expectations.evidence: 'AT.L2-3.2.1 | AT | Security awareness of risks/policies related to CUI | MET (assumed) ... Annual training in place' and 'PS.L2-3.9.1 | PS | Screen individuals before authorizing CUI access | MET ... Confirmed for all staff.'

expectations.text: Explains SPRS scoring impact using the DoD methodology: score starts from 110 with weighted deductions (5/3/1 points; MFA and FIPS crypto are 5-point/partial-credit items), and prioritises remediation by point value and POA&M eligibility
expectations.evidence: 'Starting from 110, using the known highest-impact point values...' table lists IA.L2-3.5.3 (MFA) -5, SC.L2-3.13.11 (FIPS crypto) -5, plus -3 and -1 items. Also: 'Estimated interim score: roughly 110 − 33 = ~77, which is below the 88-point minimum required for any conditional certification path...four of these are critical practices that can never sit in a POA&M regardless of score.' Remediation plan ordered by score impact (MFA listed first as 'Highest score impact').
